Join me this Friday for a **Members Only** Livestream to go Behind the Scenes of TWIL! The stream will be November 13th at 12:00 PM US Central. Become a member to watch live at https://tuxdigital.com/membership and save the Live link: https://youtu.be/xH9ZPABshTE

This week in Linux, one of the biggest Adobe alternatives announced it is finally coming to Linux, and that's just the beginning of all the exciting news!

Fedora 45 has arrived with tons of updates and the latest versions of GNOME and KDE Plasma.

Bazzite 45 has also landed and they've got some exciting news around support for Epic Games new Easy Anti Cheat.

Then we got a new desktop release from LXQt as they close a chapter that's been open for more than a decade.

And the Asahi Linux developers have made some incredible progress on Apple Silicon, including a gaming breakthrough, and there's some licensing changes for the project that has sparked some debates.

All that and so much more so let's jump into Your Source for Linux GNews and see what's happened This Week in Linux.
